scope: Baghdad metro-6car reference; reusable Iraqi manufacturing routes
cost_policy: Detail and supplier qualification only; no new capital or finance rates. Nested child content is not an additive purchase BOM.

parts.title: 60E1 reference running rail
parts.interface: CWR neutral temperature; welds; switches and deck movement
parts.acceptance: Mill certificate; weld procedure and NDT; geometry and stress-free-temperature records

parts.title: Resilient direct-fixation complete seat kit
parts.interface: Rail profile; stiffness; electrical insulation; adjustment
parts.acceptance: Supplier system tests; anchor pullout; fatigue; insulation; installed torque

parts.title: Elastic clips
parts.interface: Matched fastener system
parts.acceptance: No mixing unqualified clips, pads or baseplates

parts.title: Rail pad / bonded resilient layer
parts.interface: Hot-desert stiffness and creep
parts.acceptance: Supplier ageing and stiffness tests

parts.title: Lateral rail insulators
parts.interface: Gauge and rail-foot interface
parts.acceptance: Electrical resistance and dimensional inspection

parts.title: Anchor assembly including insert, bolt and washer
parts.interface: Two anchors per reference seat, subject to supplier pattern
parts.acceptance: Pullout, fatigue, edge distances; approved torque

parts.title: Vertical/lateral adjustment and levelling kit
parts.interface: Supplier pad stack and adjustment range
parts.acceptance: Gauge, cant, height and residual adjustment audit

parts.title: OSR-ST6 precast slab panel
parts.interface: 6 x 2.9 m, 250 mm base plus twin 380 x 160 mm plinths
parts.acceptance: Maturity, compressive strength, insert survey, crack and lifting inspection

parts.title: ST6 concrete, base and plinths only
parts.interface: Excludes trough envelope, steel and bedding
parts.acceptance: Trial mix, aggregate, cement, sulfate exposure and curing

parts.title: ST6 reinforcement planning allowance
parts.interface: 150 kg/m3 allowance; bar schedule remains design-owned
parts.acceptance: Released bar schedule, cover, cage and batch trace

parts.title: ST6 bedding / levelling grout
parts.interface: 30 mm reference bed over 17.4 m2; site adjustment required
parts.acceptance: Bearing contact, flow, shrinkage and trial installation

parts.title: ST6 lifting sockets / engineered anchors
parts.interface: Four reference lifting points; unequal load sharing must be calculated
parts.acceptance: Supplier lift design, concrete release strength, certified rig and lift plan

parts.title: Drainage channel and removable cover
parts.interface: Both sides; separate cable route from drain wet section
parts.acceptance: Hydraulic/flood design, cleanout access and proof-flow test

parts.title: Rail electrical continuity bond / monitored stray-current provision
parts.interface: Battery traction still needs earth, lightning and fault-current design
parts.acceptance: Approved bonding study, corrosion interfaces and continuity test

parts.title: Turnout slab bearer, point drive, detection and locking kit
parts.interface: Mainline, crossings and depot throat scheduled separately
parts.acceptance: Supplier turnout geometry, wheel passage and interlocking tests

parts.title: Rail/deck expansion interface and transition section
parts.interface: Not one rail expansion device per deck gap; CWR interaction required
parts.acceptance: Braking, thermal, seismic, settlement and fatigue analysis

parts.title: Utility ducts, draw pits, barriers and fencing
parts.interface: Utility and emergency access, separation and protection
parts.acceptance: Survey utility approvals, flood and evacuation review

parts.title: Underframe and load-bearing car structure
parts.interface: Metro-6car family loads, 18.5 m nominal module allocation
parts.acceptance: Family drawings; load cases; crash/fatigue and weld qualification

parts.title: Modular FRP cladding, end frames and service rails
parts.interface: Cladding is not primary crash structure; corrosion isolation
parts.acceptance: Laminate/fire/smoke, inserts, panel retention and removal trial

parts.title: Powered bogie complete including frame, suspension and brakes
parts.interface: Axle loads, pivots, swept envelope and wheel/rail match
parts.acceptance: Supplier mass/duty/curve data; dynamic and braking acceptance

parts.title: Trailer bogie complete including frame, suspension and brakes
parts.interface: Two bogies per car reference architecture
parts.acceptance: Family qualification and dimensional/functional tests

parts.title: Wheelset including wheels, axle, bearings and axleboxes
parts.interface: Child content; not an extra complete-bogie purchase
parts.acceptance: Axle fatigue, wheel profile, bearing life and traceability

parts.title: Motor and traction inverter/controller set
parts.interface: 12 sets per six-car train; 3600 kW total peak envelope
parts.acceptance: Torque-speed, cooling, EMC and duty map

parts.title: 225 kWh nameplate traction battery allocation
parts.interface: 1350 kWh gross / 1080 kWh usable per train; 675 V nominal, 740 V normal maximum
parts.acceptance: Cell/pack safety, BMS, containment, isolation and thermal propagation

parts.title: Battery support, HV junction box, fuse, contactors and precharge
parts.interface: 800 V class does not mean 800 V nominal; insulation coordinates supplier limits
parts.acceptance: Fault-current/protection selectivity, HVIL, isolation and thermal tests

parts.title: Battery/inverter liquid cooling loop
parts.interface: Pump, chiller, heat exchanger, hoses, isolation, expansion/bleed, leak sensors
parts.acceptance: Heat balance at 50 C ambient, pressure, vibration and leak test

parts.title: HV-to-LV DC/DC and battery-backed auxiliary distribution
parts.interface: Separated safety and application supplies; branch protection
parts.acceptance: Brownout, transient, short-circuit and autonomy tests

parts.title: HVAC unit, ducts, filters, condensate and mounts
parts.interface: 50 C design ambient; no unqualified LM3 thermal reuse
parts.acceptance: Fresh-air/heat balance, dust filtration and condensate trial

parts.title: Passenger door package including leaves, drive, locks and detection
parts.interface: Two double-leaf openings per side reference; Metro-6car freeze required
parts.acceptance: Force, obstruction, escape, locked proof and controller integration

parts.title: Side glazing, window frames, seals and adhesives
parts.interface: Window count depends on released car layout
parts.acceptance: Impact, retention, leak and fire/smoke requirements

parts.title: Intercar coupler, gangway, jumper and air/electrical interfaces
parts.interface: Six cars imply five intercar interfaces; end recovery couplers separate
parts.acceptance: Coupler load, gangway movement, fire barrier and cable sweep

parts.title: Train-end recovery coupler and sensor cowl
parts.interface: Rescue loads; radar radome separate from exposed ultrasonic faces
parts.acceptance: Recovery/lift trial and RF, optical and acoustic field tests

parts.title: Brake supply/control and parking brake package
parts.interface: Includes compressor, reservoir, dryer, valves, hoses and sensors; no fixed pressure without design
parts.acceptance: Stopping performance, degraded modes, pressure and leak tests

parts.title: Roof PV, MPPT, mounts and protected DC wiring
parts.interface: Car-specific usable roof area and HVAC/service clearances
parts.acceptance: Uplift, shading, isolation, bonding and maintenance access

parts.title: Interior, seats, grab rails, lighting and accessibility kit
parts.interface: 720 nominal passengers/120 seats per train; accessible route and door zone
parts.acceptance: Fixture loads, fire/smoke, lighting and accessible boarding

parts.title: Fire detection, alarm, segregation and suppression provisions
parts.interface: Battery and passenger-space hazards coordinated with emergency brake
parts.acceptance: Hazard analysis, detector coverage and integrated evacuation test

parts.title: HV/LV/data harness, connector and clamp schedule
parts.interface: Wire IDs, terminal families, cut lengths, shields and bend limits
parts.acceptance: Formboard, crimp pull test, continuity, insulation and configuration

parts.title: Service consumables, fasteners, fluids and replacement spares
parts.interface: Service intervals and inventory policy; not free nor included twice
parts.acceptance: Released consumable list, shelf-life and stock policy

parts.title: T-ECU/S end host assembly
parts.interface: Two logical channels per host; redundancy does not itself prove independence
parts.acceptance: Per-channel rails/watchdogs, relay feedback, reset and fault-injection evidence

parts.title: T-ECU/A application end host assembly
parts.interface: TCMS, ATO, recording, train-to-ground and comfort interfaces
parts.acceptance: CPU/RAM/storage, boot, bus, timeout and radio tests

parts.title: T-OBS end host and external sensor assembly
parts.interface: Radar, HAP TX lidar, stereo, ultrasonic; bench candidates pending qualification
parts.acceptance: Field coverage, contamination, stale data, power and stop-distance tests

parts.title: Safety evaluator MCU channel
parts.interface: Pico 2 for bench; custom RP2350 package needs separate pin allocation
parts.acceptance: No native CAN/RMII assumed; external controllers and measured deadlines

parts.title: Independent hardware heartbeat watchdog
parts.interface: TPS3701 is a voltage monitor, not a watchdog
parts.acceptance: Stuck high/low, late/early, reset and output inhibition tests

parts.title: Channel power conversion and voltage monitoring branch
parts.interface: Separate A/B protections and validated independence boundary
parts.acceptance: Common-cause fault study; short, UV/OV, transient and thermal trials

parts.title: Application compute module and carrier
parts.interface: CM5-compatible 5 V carrier; exact module/carrier SKU unfrozen
parts.acceptance: Carrier topology, peripherals, cooling, storage and boot power tests

parts.title: Radar evaluation assembly and CAN interface adapter
parts.interface: AWR1843BOOST: 5 V barrel, micro USB, J3 CAN; no factory M12 connector
parts.acceptance: Adapter harness, termination, firmware configuration and freshness test

parts.title: Lidar HAP TX candidate and data/power harness
parts.interface: 100BASE-TX; 9-18 V supply; no invented 12 V PoE pinout
parts.acceptance: Vendor cable/pinout, startup/inrush and timestamp test

parts.title: Stereo camera, carrier-compatible flex and rigid calibration bar
parts.interface: 22-pin carrier CSI cable family; flex length and optical geometry frozen together
parts.acceptance: Stereo calibration, image timing, vibration and thermal drift

parts.title: Ultrasonic sensing position
parts.interface: Raw piezo needs driver/AFE; HC-SR04 uses trigger and timed digital echo
parts.acceptance: Weatherproof candidate selection, acoustic apertures and blind-zone trial

parts.title: Isolated peer cross-check SPI link
parts.interface: Digital isolator directionality and local channel supplies; no USB-device-to-device link
parts.acceptance: Protocol age/CRC/sequence and short/open/babble fault injection

parts.title: Hardware series permission contacts and independent coil drivers
parts.interface: Two channels in series, feedback contacts, watchdog inhibition
parts.acceptance: Welded contact/driver short/stuck GPIO; fail restrictive truth table

parts.title: HV/LV input surge protection and branch fuse assemblies
parts.interface: Nominal 24 V bus; T-OBS reference 100 W supply envelope
parts.acceptance: Fuse coordination, voltage drop, hold-up, EMC and full-load test

parts.title: Enclosure, heat spreader, glands, vents and grounding hardware
parts.interface: Hot/dusty nose installation; no proven passive cooling claim
parts.acceptance: Thermal soak, ingress, vibration and accessible replacement

parts.title: Train network switch, isolated CAN and external Ethernet controller set
parts.interface: Redundant ring topology and cabling path allocation
parts.acceptance: Budget, timing, link loss and termination study

parts.title: Train-to-ground radios, modem carrier, antennas and surge arresters
parts.interface: M.2 modem needs correct USB/PCIe adapter and SIM support
parts.acceptance: Spectrum authority, route coverage and link-loss tests

parts.title: W-SBC field cabinet and point/crossing I/O
parts.interface: Cabinet count requires actual field I/O and network design
parts.acceptance: Power/UPS, earthing, I/O truth table and resource-control interface

parts.title: S-SBC station host and protected UPS/network enclosure
parts.interface: One station host allocation; exact redundancy by station design
parts.acceptance: Local degraded service, UPS endurance and recovery

parts.title: Operator/server cluster, backup and disaster recovery
parts.interface: Server count defined by availability and storage study
parts.acceptance: Restore drill, separation, performance and recovery objective

parts.title: Pi20/Pi25 beam, pier cap, column and foundation package
parts.interface: 20/25 m bays; actual foundation zones, spans and transport
parts.acceptance: Released loads, prestress, reinforcement, bearings, fatigue, ground and lift design

parts.title: Walkway, barrier, cable tray and access cassette
parts.interface: Clear egress, deck drainage and changeable services
parts.acceptance: Load, fall-protection, access and vibration checks

parts.title: Station accessible platform, ramp/lift/stair and canopy package
parts.interface: Platform family, train floor and evacuation capacity
parts.acceptance: Surveyed gap/step and swept clearance; drainage and egress

parts.title: Station fire, water, drainage, power and earthing services
parts.interface: Utilities, flood levels, potable/fire water and lightning
parts.acceptance: Load/hydraulic study, inspectable routing and commissioning

parts.title: Ticket validators, vending, gates and settlement terminals
parts.interface: Existing AFC/backoffice; payment and tariff contracts required
parts.acceptance: Offline/replay/refund, fare reconciliation and privacy tests

parts.title: Station PA/PIS, CCTV, help points and telecom cabinet
parts.interface: Coverage and emergency comms; does not imply one device each
parts.acceptance: Acoustic, visibility, accessibility and failover tests

parts.title: Charging contact, interlock, protection, DC/DC and site battery
parts.interface: 158 sites; actual cabinet count and kW/kWh taken from site design
parts.acceptance: Thermal/contact duty, isolation, emergency disconnect and energy simulation

parts.title: Depot lifts, pits, wheel service, wash and recovery equipment
parts.interface: Bays are not parking; 831 trainsets need release-backed stabling plan
parts.acceptance: Load/handling design, permits, wastewater and site layout

parts.title: Precast plant moulds, cage jigs, batch/curing and survey tools
parts.interface: Separate slab line from beam beds; throughput and delivery route
parts.acceptance: First article, maturity calibration and repeatability records

parts.title: Rail weld/clip/anchor tools and track survey trolley
parts.interface: Possession, calibration and maintainability
parts.acceptance: Qualified operators, calibration, weld/NDT and installation trials

parts.title: Electrical bench, harness formboards and EMC/environmental test access
parts.interface: Production end-of-line and independent verification
parts.acceptance: Golden configuration, calibration, test record and repair trace
